title: One and eightpence too much, Mr Dedalus said drily
html_source:
Perhaps this is just Mr Dedalus' generalized, cranky humor, but it is probably antisemitic. The men have taken pains to point out that Reuben J Dodd is Jewish (“of the tribe of Reuben”) and ridiculed him for paying his son’s rescuer so little (“like a hero” probably an expression of the prejudicial view that Dodd is a penny pincher).

If so, Mr Dedalus takes this further, observing that the child wasn’t even worth that little. Again, if so, the comfort with which the men in the carriage make these “jokes” in front of Bloom demonstrates the pervasiveness of this prejudice.

There may also be buried in this joke a hint at how little Mr Dedalus values his own son Stephen.
